name: Oh-My-Pi
description: Oh-My-Pi (omp) is a terminal-based AI coding agent with hash-anchored edits, LSP integration, built-in tools, subagents, and support for 40+ model providers. A batteries-included fork of Pi by Mario Zechner, exposed via ttyd for browser-based terminal access.

notes.text: Open http://<container-ip> in a browser; the first run launches the setup wizard.
Browser access uses ttyd, which has no authentication by default. Restrict port 80 with a reverse proxy or firewall before exposing it publicly.
